prompts.front: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input1 is the EXACT orthographic geometry/camera/silhouette constraint for a connected cliff-land 3D modeling reference. Input2 is STONE SURFACE STYLE ONLY from the user's target, not its landscape, objects or camera. Refine input1 into an ancient-Chinese stylized neutral light-grey clay cliff. Preserve its exact camera, aspect proportions, outer silhouette, broad quiet upper ground, main plane turns and connected inward lower closure. Do NOT rotate, mirror, zoom, thicken or redesign the volume. Add restrained natural stone shaping INSIDE that silhouette: a few broad oblique secondary fracture planes, small chipped corners and shallow stone roughness, making it natural rock instead of manufactured cut walls. Keep continuous large geological faces; no boulder pile, no repeated columns, no terraces, no blocks stuck on, no separate base or pointy sole. Make major face widths unequal. Uniform grey matte clay, soft diffuse studio lighting revealing all faces including back, white background, no floor, no contact shadow, no grass/soil/plants/props/water/fog/text/collage. ONE independent modeling view only. Preserve image1's apparent width/height ratio strictly; detail amplitude at most3percent of object width. This is the FRONT view. Keep this exact view; front clefts exist only where visible in image1, side/back get their own calm broad planes. No front-face duplication on side/back.
